node.title: Read UUID on macOS from script
node.author: Anonymous Monk
node.doctext:
Hello monks

I can read the UUID from Terminal with the following:

ioreg -d2 -c IOPlatformExpertDevice | awk -F\" '/IOPlatformUUID/{print $(NF-1)}'

I need to do the same from a Perl script. My solution is not working:

$UUID = (`ioreg -d2 -c IOPlatformExpertDevice | awk -F\" '/IOPlatformUUID/{print $(NF-1)}'`); print $UUID;

It is complaining with sh: -c: line 0: unexpected EOF while looking for matching `"'. Why?
